provenance.tool: hand computation; tests/reference/derive_models.py (Python 3.13 standard library: fractions, decimal, random)
provenance.steps: Window 2024-02-29 to 2024-07-31, six month ends; a loan-month belongs to the window when its month end t does. Monthly sums by hand from loan_months.csv: MTG_FIX EUR P / A = 3,000 / 150,000; 1,500 / 100,000; 4,400 / 110,000 (E3 FULL 2,000 included); 0 / 90,000 (E4 DEFAULT in neither sum); 2,500 / 125,000; 8,000 / 80,000 (E2 A = 25,000 - 250 + 5,250, the drawdown counted). MTG_FIX USD: 500 / 50,000; 1,000 / 50,000; 0 / 50,000; 2,000 / 40,000; 0 / 40,000; 400 / 40,000. The rows of 2024-01-31 and 2024-08-31 are outside the window. PM0 = 1 - (prod (1 - SMM(t)))^(12/6), computed exactly in rationals by derive_models.realised from these hand sums, without rates.py or models.py, and rounded to 40 significant digits. The same script gives three figures the case rules out: the average of the six monthly CPRs, the CPR of the window-pooled SMM (sum P / sum A over the window) and the CPR of the mean monthly SMM.
